newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures ended mostly firmer in after-hours trade on Thursday, as sentiment that prices were too low after recent downward trends, spurred sporadic technical buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen up than the day's close. Benchmark July ended up 0.5 yen at 144.1 yen.
Volume was extremely thin with only 2,203 lots traded.

"Market players were divided over near-term direction amid a lack of decisive incentives. Prices are likely to hover within narrow ranges at least until after the Chinese New Year holidays," one trader said.
